style: Energetic, athletic and increasingly tactical under Mauricio Pochettino. The USMNT press aggressively, transition quickly and lean on a core of European-based talent. Built around Pulisic's wide creativity, a hard-working midfield and pace in the final third.
recent_form: Co-hosts carrying home-tournament pressure and expectation. A squad evenly split between Qatar 2022 veterans and World Cup debutants, with striker Folarin Balogun the most in-form attacker. Opened their Group D campaign against Paraguay at SoFi Stadium.

key_players.name: Christian Pulisic
key_players.note: AC Milan forward and most-capped attacker (84+ caps); the team's leading creator and on-field leader, decisive from the left.

key_players.name: Weston McKennie
key_players.note: Juventus do-it-all midfielder who covers ground, contributes goals and drives the central engine.

key_players.name: Tyler Adams
key_players.note: Tenacious ball-winner who anchors midfield and sets the pressing tone; a vocal leader.

key_players.name: Folarin Balogun
key_players.note: Most in-form USMNT attacker entering the tournament, scoring in nine of his last 11 Ligue 1 matches; expected to start up top.

key_players.name: Tim Weah
key_players.note: Pacey wide attacker and Qatar 2022 scorer offering directness and width.

key_players.name: Haji Wright
key_players.note: Physical striker and Qatar 2022 scorer providing a different attacking profile off the bench or in rotation.

historical_news: Co-hosts of the 2026 World Cup alongside Canada and Mexico, with home advantage and unprecedented national attention.
Reached the World Cup quarterfinals in 2002, their best modern finish, before a controversial exit to Germany.
Failed to qualify for the 2018 World Cup, a national low point that triggered a rebuild around a young 'golden generation'.
Reached the round of 16 at the 2022 World Cup in Qatar before losing to the Netherlands.
Hired Mauricio Pochettino to bring elite tactical pedigree and raise expectations for the home tournament.
Pressure narrative: a talented but inconsistent generation expected to deliver a deep run on home soil.

media_sentiment.label: neutral
media_sentiment.summary: Mixed-to-hopeful; home advantage and Pochettino's pedigree fuel optimism, but inconsistent results and a young core leave doubts about how deep they can go.
